name: Kuon
source: The adopted son of Neyris's grandmother. He's the general of an army that he raised himself. He's a serious person, focused on the idea of creating the first kingdom for dark magicians. Kuon doesn’t even want to know about romance and love, because in his opinion it is just a waste of time. He cares for Neyris as if she were his real sister.
